note: Year-round private RV park on the north edge of Dickinson (2320 Buckskin Dr; the operator gives 547 Chestnut Lane as the GPS address). Gravel pull-through and back-in sites in long rows beside farmland, away from train and highway noise. Tent sites for overnight travelers and touring cyclists. --Claude
summary: Operator site read in full: $55/night for two adults (+$5 each over 12), Good Sam 10% off nightly -> $49.50, weekly $330, monthly by call. Every overnight site full hookups 30/50 A; pull-throughs and back-ins; heated showers, laundry, wifi. Open all year (water on at select pull-throughs). Reserve by phone or request form. Google 4.5 (387). Price gate passes on the Good Sam exception; long-stay tests pass (operator courts overnight guests, recent reviews are travelers). Not waterfront stands. Pin ~25 m from Google's point; ~200-230 m from the RV rows (no move).
flags: PRICE GATE: $55 > $50, passes on the Good Sam exception: the operator posts 'Good Sam Members receive a 10% Discount on Nightly Stays!' ($55 x 0.9 = $49.50). No gateway applies (Theodore Roosevelt NP South Unit/Medora is ~57 km).

LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE (Dickinson oil patch): the operator's wording courts nightly guests: 'whether you plan to stay for a night, a week, or longer, we want to make your stay the very best!'; 'Each Overnight RV Site provides full hook-ups'; 'Both Pull through & Back In Sites are available for overnight guests'; 'Late Overnight Arrivals Welcome!' with an after-hours kiosk; 'Adventure Cyclists are Welcome!'. Weekly and monthly rates exist; the about page also says 'Overnight Seasonal' and 'Tent Sites are Available for Overnight Travelers'. No mention of workers, crews or leases. Nightly share NOT countable from the operator (no site counts or map): imagery shows the northern rows as roughly 30 long angled pull-throughs, mostly empty, and the southern back-in rows densely filled with parked rigs that look long-term. Estimated nightly share ~half or more; passes. Google 4.5 / 387 reviews; the newest reviews (Nov 2026 back to Aug) are travelers: '9 nights, full hookup', 'When traveling in a camper van, the shower house is important'.
